game.name: The Legend of Zelda
game.rules:
The basis for our rules is that gameplay behaviors should be replicable with a simple setup: original console, cart, controller. Hardware modifications and third party devices should not cause the game to run faster and should comply to other rules.

HARDWARE PLATFORMS -- 
Official Nintendo platforms are listed in the left side bar. 
Modifications to original hardware that improve audio/video output quality are allowed. (e.g. RGB and stereo mods)
Recommendations for emulator cores follow: 
* PC/x86 (Windows/MacOS/Linux/BSD): Mesen, Nestopia UE, puNES, Nintendulator, Bizhawk (Neshawk), higan, FCEU(X/mm)
* Mobile/ARM (Android/iOS): Nestopia as libretro core (e.g. Retroarch), Nostalgia.NES
* In your submission comments, please indicate what emulator, FPGA, or RGB mod was used. No comment = Original unmodified hardware

GAME OPERATION -- 
* Do not alter the ROM from its original release, excepting the use of "Patches" found in our Resources link.
* Do not watch or alter RAM.
* Do not alter CPU/PPU clock rates. 
* Do not skip lag frames, such as by using "Run Ahead".
* Do not prevent sprite flicker by allowing more than 8 sprites per scanline.

INPUT DEVICES -- 
You may use any input device or combination of devices that comply with the following rules.
* Do not automate or mechanize inputs†, such as with macros or turbo.
* Bind game inputs to only one button on your devices. E.G. Do not bind P1 Select to your controller and your keyboard.
* Bind only one input per device button. 
† P2 Up+A, which forces a Game Over when done in inventory, is excepted from this rule. You may force a game over with one input. Examples: bind P2 Up+A to a single button; or, put a rubber band around one button and press the other when desired.

SUBMISSION VIDEOS -- 
* Videos must be permanent. Do not submit from a Twitch Broadcast.  Highlight the run, or upload/export to Youtube.
* Videos must include the last Power On or Reset.
* Video quality doesn't need to be perfect, but videos with excessive frame loss or compression artifacting may be rejected.

categories.name: Second Quest No Up+A
categories.rules:
Timing begins with control of Link on the Overworld. Timing ends with loss of control upon standing next to Zelda.
Up&A on Controller 2 is not allowed. Deaths are allowed if they do not lead to a time save.
All runs must begin from system reset or power cycle.  Beginning from RETRY, SAVE, or CONTINUE is not permitted.

Please use the Forum or contact moderators if you have questions.

categories.name: Second Quest 100%
categories.rules:
Timing begins with control of Link on the Overworld. Timing ends with loss of control upon standing next to Zelda. 
All runs must begin from system reset or power cycle.  Beginning from RETRY, SAVE, or CONTINUE is not permitted.

Items required at the end: Bow, both Bomb upgrades, Magic Boomerang, Raft, Ladder, Recorder, Wand, Red Candle, Bible/Magic Book, Magic Key, Red Ring, Silver Arrows, Power Bracelet, Letter, all Heart Containers, all Triforce pieces.

Do not pay Heart Containers to Old Men.

categories.name: Second Quest Low%
categories.rules:
Timing begins with control of Link on the Overworld. Timing ends with loss of control upon standing next to Zelda. 

This is a run that requires the player to complete the game with as few upgrades as possible. Only those required to win the game are permitted. When the game ends, the player should have only 3 hearts and wooden sword. 

Link must not acquire: 

Heart containers (Including Level 1 Aquamentus heart) 
Letter 
Blue Potion 
Red Potion 
Bomb Upgrades 
White Sword 
Magic Sword 
Blue Ring 
Red Ring 
Magic Shield 
Wooden Boomerang 
Magic Boomerang 
Wand 
Red Candle 
Book/Bible 
Magic Key

All runs must begin from system reset or power cycle.  Beginning from RETRY, SAVE, or CONTINUE is not permitted.

categories.name: Second Quest Swordless
categories.rules:
Timing begins with control of Link on the Overworld.  Timing ends the instant Link holds up the Triforce in Gannon's room.

No swords. Ever.
Run Ends at Gannon

All runs must begin from system reset or power cycle.  Beginning from RETRY, SAVE, or CONTINUE is not permitted.

categories.name: Second Quest Extreme Rules
categories.rules:
Timing begins with control of Link on the Overworld.  Timing ends the instant Link holds up the Triforce in Gannon's room, or upon gaining control in your final room after entering Gannon's room earlier.

No Glitches (including, but not limited to re-entering dungeons to unlock doors, block/ladder clips, screen/map wraps, roocorder, using up+A to keep your Bait after using it, item duplication)
No block clips or screen scrolls of any kind. Any run that passes into a block or intended boundary for any reason is not valid.

No Swords
No Extra Hearts
No Potions
No Rings
No Boomerangs
No Red Candle
No Magic Book
No Magic Key
No Magic Shield
All Maps/Compasses

Must Obtain Both Bomb Upgrades
Must Obtain Silver Arrow
No Killing Overworld Enemies
Must Kill Every Boss/Miniboss (Lanmola, Moldorm, Patra, Anything That Ends a Dungeon)
Must Visit Every Dungeon Room
Run Ends at Gannon (or on control gain in your final room after entering Gannon's room earlier)

All runs must begin from system reset or power cycle.  Beginning from RETRY, SAVE, or CONTINUE is not permitted.

categories.name: ACE
categories.rules:
Save Princess Zelda, using ACE or other major sequence breaks.
All runs must begin from system reset or power cycle.  Beginning from RETRY, SAVE, or CONTINUE is not permitted.

Currently, this only exists for the Second Quest. ACE is not possible in First Quest.

Helpful Tips:
ACE works on Japanese v1.0 or v1.1 FDS disk images.
Mods will remove load times. For Wii VC runs, we removes 3.5 seconds (210 frames);
for Gamecube version 3.616 seconds (217 frames).
FDS hardware and emulation load times vary.

runList.comment:
Played on N8 Pro Everdrive, RGB modded NES. 
Crazy run! 27:42.734 was my frame count using avidemux. 6 BST by a lot and wasn't really nervous, was just playing for fun and felt like this was a well executed run. Outside of slow-ish 2 (despite having loads of rupees) and 3 right gannon's, very very solid run.
gaming!
My greatest achievement
First attempt in 2016; finally took world record. :)
Very nice run, just little bit of issues with ressources in 5 and a slow 8, rest was very good
Played on AV Famicom x Everdrive N8

What rust?  

Played on RGB-modded NES2 using 3-screw cart & CHX Brick controller.
Aw yeah I finished the run without passing out, most nervous I've been in a while

After what felt like a long 3 months, I pushed my time lower. I expected a larger improvement and what's great about speedrunning is that your hopes aren't dashed if you PB even by a little. 10 seconds is HUGE at this stage of this game and category for me. I hope to make these times the new norm.
Larisse teaches aerobics and loves short shorts, unicorns, and reruns of Three's Company.

Finally did it! Very fast run for me, except level 8...

Played on RGB AV Famicom + Everdrive N8 Pro.
The 28!

Control of Link begins at 0:10.733
Control of Link ends at 29:05.167

Nets out to 28:54.434

The 28! Technically my second, but this is the one that counts! A gold 2, solid 5, River Room bomb-force 7, and a sub-2 8 all contributed greatly. Early game was also mostly clean with a manipulated 2:07 (Steak Sauce strikes again). First time really going for things like skipping the Armos 30. Never going back! Good game!

The goal has been achieved!  Huge shoutouts to the entire Z1 community for the tremendous help.  

Truly a great community.  

Big shoutouts to JSR for pushing me with positivity and teaching me the manip.  A shoutout to Schicksal and GM for helping me polish some things that were holding me back.

And finally, a big shoutout to my amazing community, for truly pushing me and showing so much positivity when I was frustrated the most with this grind.
Just need that better start, but I like the early route here.
Team RF
New PB
This was a fun one. Played on RGB modded nes.
Retimed down to 29:35 (manip timer); GGs!
Finally did it!  Of course, still loads of time to save everywhere.

frame counted to 29:44.500

let's goooooo!!!
Discord Run that went way too fast way too quick.  Ridiculously fast pace out of 7 that I blew due to nerves. But PB is a PB I suppose

Sub 30!

Huge thanks to Arcus and his sub 30 run for getting me interested, to JSR for being super supportive, and Prawnzo for having a good zelda stream to watch and learn from. The entire Zelda community was great and the best speedrunning community I've been a part of. I was able to do this at my pace only because of all the help from other players and piggybacking off of things they already discovered.

I can go lower -- but I'm not sure if I will! Might just come back to it someday.

This took me almost two months to the day from my first submission and was quite a grind. I had 5,171 attempts over this time period, 3,879 of them being double hundo and 1,292 being the neo Khananaroute. Most of these reset within the first 50 seconds, but it takes 10 seconds to grab your sword and be able to move again -- that means over all these attempts I've spent over 14 hours grabbing that wooden sword. o_o

I completed 21 runs total over my two livesplits files, with this being my 14th PB. This is not an easy game, but getting sub 30 is definitely a grind that is worth doing.

Also, JSR was right. Use a CRT, it's so much better than emulator.

Shoutout Antlerz44





With this run, I became the first person EVER to beat the original

- Super Mario Bros. in Sub 5

- Metroid in Sub 10

- Legend of Zelda in Sub 30



...for the NES. THE original Holy Trinity of Nintendo franchises!

SUB 30!!!  Back half of 9 could have been waaaay better, so I kind of HAVE to keep going lol (might even be a 29:55 after watching it, but its no big deal.  Im just happy I finally got it. Ill be improving this time soon anyway)
